title: Deer holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 28 Q60 38 58 46 Q56 52 54 56' stroke='#ffdd66' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='20' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#ff4466'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='20' rx='12' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#ff7799' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- Balloon highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='15' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#ffaabb' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Balloon knot -->
  <polygon points='60,33 64,33 62,36' fill='#cc2244'/>
  
  <!-- Deer body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='70' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#c47a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='70' rx='16' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='#e09a55' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Deer legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='78' width='4' height='12' rx='2' fill='#a8622a'/>
  <rect x='38' y='79' width='4' height='11' rx='2' fill='#a8622a'/>
  <rect x='46' y='78' width='4' height='12' rx='2' fill='#a8622a'/>
  <rect x='52' y='79' width='4' height='11' rx='2' fill='#a8622a'/>
  
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='88' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5a3018'/>
  <rect x='38' y='88' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5a3018'/>
  <rect x='46' y='88' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5a3018'/>
  <rect x='52' y='88' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5a3018'/>
  
  <!-- Deer neck -->
  <rect x='40' y='52' width='10' height='12' rx='4' fill='#c47a3a'/>
  
  <!-- Deer head -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='48' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#d48845'/>
  
  <!-- Ear left -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='38' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#d48845' transform='rotate(-20 36 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='38' rx='2' ry='4.5' fill='#ffbb88' transform='rotate(-20 36 38)'/>
  
  <!-- Ear right -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='38' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#d48845' transform='rotate(20 60 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='38' rx='2' ry='4.5' fill='#ffbb88' transform='rotate(20 60 38)'/>
  
  <!-- Antlers -->
  <path d='M40 40 L36 32 L33 34 M36 32 L37 26' stroke='#8a5020' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 40 L60 32 L63 34 M60 32 L59 26' stroke='#8a5020' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='47' r='2.2' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='47' r='2.2' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <circle cx='43.7' cy='46.3' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='53.7' cy='46.3' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='53' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#5a3018'/>
  <ellipse cx='47.2' cy='52.5' rx='1' ry='0.7' fill='#886644'/>
  
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M45 55 Q48 57 51 55' stroke='#6a4020' stroke-width='0.9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Arm holding balloon string -->
  <path d='M54 62 Q58 58 56 52' stroke='#c47a3a' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Other arm -->
  <path d='M30 65 Q26 68 25 72' stroke='#c47a3a' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Tail -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='66' r='3' fill='#ffbb88'/>
  
  <!-- Belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='9' ry='8' fill='#e8b070' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
